option_relations.rationale: The option describes a specific type of myocarditis, which is not directly related to the general concept of cytokine release syndrome.
The option describes a channelopathy with ventricular fibrillation, which is not directly related to the general concept of cytokine release syndrome.
COVID-19-associated cytokine storm is clinically equivalent to cytokine release syndrome, especially with cardiac involvement as described in the option.
The option describes a channelopathy, specifically long QT syndrome, which is not directly related to the general concept of cytokine release syndrome.
